cohort: The study included 2,796 Chinese pregnant women with singleton delivery, categorized into groups based on pre-pregnancy obesity and gestational abnormal glucose metabolism.
finding: Maternal pre-pregnancy obesity and GAGM were independently associated with increased risks of adverse pregnancy outcomes, and their combination dramatically heightened these risks compared to either condition alone.
mod_finding: Maternal pre-pregnancy obesity, GAGM, and their combination were all significantly associated with increased risks of cesarean delivery.
